Delta Species

Released October 31, 2005 · 114 cards

Delta Species is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on October 31, 2005. Its main set has 113 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (114 in total). It includes 95 Pokémon, 14 Trainer and 5 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

29 illustrators worked on Delta Species. Most cards: Ryo Ueda (12), Yuka Morii (10), Masakazu Fukuda (9), Mitsuhiro Arita (9), Hajime Kusajima (8), Midori Harada (8), Hisao Nakamura (6), Kouki Saitou (6).
